column1: # A PolyC driver that merely returns a fixed exit status cannot PASS.
# This witness therefore EXECUTES the frozen compile route end to end
# and checks the PRODUCED OBJECT, not the process status alone.
# THE MIGRATED COMPILER'S OBJECT IS BYTE-IDENTICAL TO THE ORACLE'S
# The G0 oracle and the migrated compiler were both run over the SAME
# fixture with the SAME install prefix, in the SAME directory, and
# their produced objects are BYTE-IDENTICAL. The migration changed
# WHO MAKES THE DECISION; it did not change WHAT THE COMPILER
